_doc: Sandown, Isle of Wight. The 1973 case: two children on the Levels met a thing in a yellow pointed hat that 'was all colours' and took them into a hut full of dials. In May 1994 the children are adults and the town is on its bank holiday. Hidden truth: hoax, a holiday-camp entertainer's act. The tide is the clock: the beach under Culver, the slipway and a cave open at low water. District content lives in data/cases/sandown/*.json.
name: Sandown

observations.text: Yellow pointed hat, taller than a man with it on
It is all colours. The colour keeps changing
A voice with no breath in it
Berries in a ring, one of every colour
Dials. Walls of dials, and the sea behind them
It is laughing. It thinks this is a show
